title: The Warm Ashes
text: A campfire is still warm, set exactly the way you set yours, the stones in the same ring and the wood in the same stack. Someone is a few hours ahead of you, or a few hours behind. Their bootprints match yours.

options.label: Rest by the fire while it lasts; whoever built it is not here.

outcomes.text: The warmth goes to the bone, and nobody comes.

options.label: The craftiest sets a trap and waits to learn who walks in your bootprints.

outcomes.text: They come back for the fire, and you are ready.

options.label: Push on before they return, and leave no trail for them to follow.

outcomes.text: You make good time, leaving nothing to follow.
